title: Thai Lamb Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Thai-inspired curry made with lamb and a blend of spices. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
2. Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
3. Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
4. Add the curry paste to the pot and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
5. Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
6. Return the lamb to the pot and bring to a boil.
7. Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1 1/2 hours.
8. Stir in the fish sauce and brown sugar.
9. Serve the curry over nutty rice.
10. Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
